name: Thermal Management in EVs
summary:
Thermal Management in EVs is an immersive VR training application designed exclusively for learners enrolled in the Immersive Learn Thermal Management in EVs micro-credential program. The application provides interactive, hands-on training focused on electric vehicle thermal management systems, including battery cooling, heat transfer principles, thermal system components, safety procedures, inspection techniques, diagnostics, and troubleshooting workflows.
